categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in information system integration, offering services such as enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform solutions, network information security planning, backup and disaster recovery solutions, financial institution information integration, cloud monitoring management, application software development, document digitization, logistics warehouse management systems, insurance industry IT consulting, and outsourced IT equipment maintenance. It also provides software services including project development, commercial software customization, software quality management, and after-sales maintenance services. Additionally, the company specializes in insurance core systems, logistics management, and professional imaging services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multi-cloud management platforms, container architecture integration, AI-powered intelligent operation platforms, virtualization and remote backup systems, and cross-platform NAS/SAN storage solutions. It integrates AI and automation technologies such as RPA and AIoT for smart logistics and warehouse management. The company also develops proprietary software products and employs advanced software quality control tools. Its imaging services utilize professional scanning and indexing technologies combined with proprietary software for document management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include financial institutions, government agencies, public utilities, healthcare organizations, manufacturing industries, and insurance companies. The company serves vertical markets such as finance, insurance, logistics, and healthcare by providing tailored IT solutions and consulting services. It also supports enterprises requiring cloud migration, IT infrastructure modernization, and data security enhancements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with additional overseas operations, including subsidiaries in Hong Kong and international markets. It maintains a network of branch offices across Taiwan to support local clients and has strategic partnerships with global technology vendors to serve multinational customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions mainly as a midstream system integrator and IT service provider. It sources hardware and software products from major global suppliers and integrates these into customized solutions for end customers. It also provides downstream after-sales maintenance and consulting services, positioning itself as a comprehensive IT solutions provider within the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding multi-cloud management capabilities, developing AI-integrated intelligent operation platforms, enhancing cybersecurity solutions, and promoting ESG-related IT applications such as enterprise carbon management. The company invests in R&D for AIoT applications in smart logistics, warehouse management optimization using AI, and software quality assurance tools. It also focuses on digital transformation services for financial and insurance sectors and continuous innovation in imaging and document management technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of integrated IT solutions, software licensing, project-based system development, and ongoing maintenance and consulting services. The company also earns income from hardware and software product sales sourced from global vendors. Additional revenue streams include outsourced IT equipment management and specialized professional services in vertical markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other IT system integrators and service providers in Taiwan and the Asia-Pacific region, including firms specializing in cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and vertical market IT services. It differentiates itself through deep expertise in finance, insurance, logistics, and imaging markets, strong vendor partnerships, and comprehensive after-sales support. The company holds a solid market position as a trusted integrator with diversified service offerings and a focus on innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported operating revenue of approximately NT$2.25 billion, representing a slight decline of 3.94% from the prior year. Operating profit was NT$72 million with a net profit of NT$67 million, reflecting a decrease compared to the previous year. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets of about NT$2.16 billion and equity of NT$1.26 billion. Despite recent revenue contraction due to discontinuation of certain agency businesses, the company continues to invest in growth areas such as cloud and AI services.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive, end-to-end IT integration capabilities tailored to vertical industries, combining cloud infrastructure, AI-driven intelligent operations, cybersecurity, and ESG IT solutions. It offers customized software modules and professional consulting to meet specific industry needs, backed by strong after-sales service and maintenance. Its unique value lies in leveraging deep domain expertise in finance, insurance, logistics, and imaging markets to deliver reliable, innovative, and sustainable IT solutions that reduce operational risks and enhance business efficiency.
